test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some peas are pineapples.

No pineapple is a broccoli.

All broccolis are potatoes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some peas being potatoes is a possibility.

II. All pineapples being potatoes is a possibility.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Statements:**

Some peas are pineapples.

No pineapple is a broccoli.

All broccolis are potatoes.

__**Venn Diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f545215de2ab98ab30f2ef00129daa623803d6d0d9c36d2da4f707da92f864c.png] 

**Conclusion:**

1. Some peas being potatoes is a possibility ⇒ **True **(There is no direct relation between peas and potatoes. So, it is possible Some peas are potatoes. So, the conclusion is definite relation.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ac76dc4d9c9aaceb6745bc6200f7e3151fdf817878ffe9f1e204df24cf4e97f.png] 

2. All pineapples being potatoes is a possibility ⇒ **True **(There is no direct relation between pineapples and potatoes. So, it is possible all pineapples are potatoes. So, so the conclusion is definite relation.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e00ac871796bc2949e06fdba65dcbd65c407918e69ca3acaf1ec4478f33d61df.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
